result.summary: Implemented PLP Quick View modal feature with 6 new files and 2 modified overrides

architecture_decisions.reuse: ProductView with showDeliveryOptions={false} — no component cloning
architecture_decisions.ssr_safety: Trigger uses isMounted pattern; modal body gated on isOpen
architecture_decisions.add_to_cart_modal: No second AddToCartModal — reuses existing useAddToCartModalContext via ProductView internals
architecture_decisions.set_bundle_exclusion: Trigger returns null for product.type.set || product.type.bundle (FR-014)
architecture_decisions.provider_placement: QuickViewProvider wraps route children inside BaseApp's provider tree, ensuring access to commerce SDK providers
